patches.description: Job-owned Mesa caches, fixed ACO validation policy, cooperative compiler checkpoints, explicitly unavailable external disassembler.

source_boundary.selection: Exact source/header/generator closure for the complete SPIR-V/NIR/ACO compiler. Other-generation encoding tables remain upstream dependencies; runtime admission is fixed to Picasso GFX9 wave64. Generated opcode tables use C++23 constant initialization, with global constructors rejected.
